subject: general
question: As of October 2020, who is the Vice President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is** __M Venkaiah Naidu.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​M. Venkaiah Naidu** is the 13th Vice President of India. In the office, 11 August 2017- 10 August 2022.
 
• The vice president is also a member of the Parliament of India as the** ex officio chairman of the Rajya Sabha.**
 
• The** Vice President **is responsible for the coordination of the activities of the Association.
 
• The office of vice president is the** second-highest constitutional office **after the president.​ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **​​Meira Kumar **was appointed as the first Woman Speaker of Lok Sabha from 2009 to 2014 in the** 15th Lok Sabha.**
 
• **Sumitra Mahajan **is an Indian politician who was the Speaker of **Lok Sabha from 2014 to 2019.**
 
• **Hamid Ansari **is an Indian politician and the** 12th vice president **of India from 2007 to 2017.
